statement: bun rules/check.ts is one command whose exit code is red when the register, the style gate or folder width is red, each alone.
source: coordinator 09-30 (PR #71 review: a skipped or deleted gate test must turn the gate red)

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it
layers.quint: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec models it
layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-COMPOSE a failing register alone is 1
a failing style gate alone is 1
a failing folder width alone is 1
a throw planted in kernel/ exits 1 and names the file
a throw planted in chain/ exits 1 (chain is inside the gate)
a folder of 11 source files exits 1 and names the folder
the register part alone turns the command red: a scratch copy has no contract tests to carry the ids
an ignored folder planted before the copy stays out of it, and what git lists comes along
the real pure/ copies without the ignored folders a seeds run leaves in it
